added_since_deploy.name: admin_request_trace_middleware
added_since_deploy.scope: Admin router only: applied in admin_router() at crates/cc-lb-server/src/app.rs:2366 after with_browser_security_headers; covers cc_lb_admin::router, server_state_router and internal_partials routes; proxy_router unchanged
added_since_deploy.description: Generates req_admin_{uuidv7} per admin request, opens tracing span 'admin.request' (request_id, http.request.method, http.route, http.response.status_code, handler_ms), inserts 'x-request-id' and appends 'Server-Timing: rid;desc=<same opaque ID>' without a duration, and logs 'admin_response_head_ready'. handler_ms measures response-head generation only; the body is not read or buffered. Resource Timing IDs require external backend joining; cached responses can retain an earlier ID.

added_since_deploy.name: sqlx pool acquire timing at DEBUG
added_since_deploy.description: Sets .acquire_time_level(log::LevelFilter::Debug) on PgPoolOptions and SqlitePoolOptions so sqlx logs pool acquisition timing at DEBUG. Acquire elapsed covers the whole acquire call (checkout wait plus connect and test_before_acquire work), not pure pool wait; query elapsed is not pure DB time.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Returns full status object including principals, plugin_chain_summary, killswitch, last_reload_status, restart_required_changes.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Returns simplified status object containing only version, git_sha, rust_version, profile, target, uptime_secs, replica_id, generation, upstreams.
changed_contracts.impact: Clients expecting killswitch, principals, or restart_required_changes in /admin/v1/status receive undefined in latest.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Accepts query params: since, until, limit, principal_id. No actor filtering. No SensitiveRead authorization enforcement.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Accepts additional query params: actor_authority, actor_subject. Enforces validation that both actor params must be supplied together and cannot be combined with principal_id. Enforces SensitiveRead authorization.
changed_contracts.impact: In deployed, querying by actor_authority or actor_subject is ignored/not supported. In latest, missing permissions return 403 Forbidden.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Fetches event detail from storage without RBAC check or audit logging.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (returns 403 if unauthorized) and logs 'request_event_detail_read' audit event.
changed_contracts.impact: Requires authenticated identity with read permission in latest.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Exports config and chains without RBAC check or audit logging.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (403 on denial) and logs 'config_export' audit event (500 audit_write_failed if audit write fails).

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Accepts arbitrary extra JSON fields in request body; uses best-effort audit emission.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Enforces serde(deny_unknown_fields) on IssueKeyRequest; uses record_issue_audit_or_revoke (rolls back key creation if audit write fails).
changed_contracts.impact: Stricter payload validation and transactional audit guarantees in latest.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Lists keys for principal without SensitiveRead check or audit logging.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (403 if unauthorized) and logs 'principal_keys_list' audit event.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Logs audit record with hardcoded actor 'admin' and principal_id 'admin'.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Logs audit record with resolved actor metadata (actor_authority, actor_subject, actor_kind, actor_email).
changed_contracts.impact: Audit records contain structured actor identity in latest.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Synchronously checks localStorage for cclb_admin_token. If found, mounts children immediately. Form submit sets localStorage and unblocks without API validation.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Asynchronously calls GET /admin/v1/auth/session to validate token and identify actor. Shows loading spinner. Differentiates between static_token and external auth mode.
changed_contracts.impact: In deployed, the app will never make a network request on startup to verify the token, and does not support external auth redirect.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Admin Token card is unconditionally rendered.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Admin Token card is conditionally rendered only when auth_mode === 'static_token'.
changed_contracts.impact: Under external auth in latest, Admin Token card is hidden.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Table has 6 columns: Revision, Applied, Upstreams, Principals, Plugins, TLS.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Table has 3 columns: Revision, Applied, TLS.
changed_contracts.impact: UI columns removed to match backend HistorySummary simplification.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Returns audit entries oldest first (ORDER BY id/seq ASC) via AuditStore::query_audit / query_audit_by_actor.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: returns entries newest first (ORDER BY ts DESC, id/seq DESC) via new AuditStore::query_recent_audit with AuditQueryScope (All | Principal | Actor); scope filters apply before LIMIT. 'after' remains an exclusive lower time bound (since = max(since, after+1)), not a forward pagination cursor. Ascending query_audit/query_audit_by_actor trait methods remain defined but are no longer used by the HTTP audit handler.
changed_contracts.impact: Entry order reverses vs deployed; clients paging by position see newest-first pages. Candidate only - not committed or deployed.

changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: UpstreamResponse adds base_url (Option<Url>, serialized as nullable string); frontend UpstreamSchema (web/src/lib/api.ts:784) requires the base_url key (nullable) and createUpstreamFromOauthDraft parses the response through UpstreamSchema.
changed_contracts.impact: Deployed responses lack base_url; candidate frontend schema validation fails against a backend that omits the key. Candidate only.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: Omitted label becomes empty string; both stores run validate_identifier on the empty label and reject it; any KeyStoreError maps to 500.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: empty label skips validate_identifier on both SqliteStorage and PostgresStorage (label optional); KeyStoreError::Storage(InvalidInput{field,reason}) maps to 400 {error:'invalid_input',field,reason}; other errors remain 500.
changed_contracts.impact: Key issuance without a label succeeds in candidate; client input errors surface as 400 invalid_input instead of 500. Candidate only.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: handleSave has no reentrancy guard; blur after Enter (or rapid Enter/blur) can issue a second PUT /admin/v1/upstreams/{id} with a stale spec_revision.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: saveStartedRef latch allows a single submission per edit session; entering edit mode resets the latch; Escape sets the latch so the subsequent blur cannot save.
changed_contracts.impact: Duplicate rename submissions eliminated in candidate. Candidate only.

changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: enable/disable invalidates only ['principals']; allowed_models, default_limits and cache_keepalive PATCH invalidate ['principal',id]+['principals']; router-terminal PUT invalidates only ['router-terminal',id]. Router revision shown by useRouterTerminal can stay stale after non-router principal mutations.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: all five mutations plus the router-terminal PUT funnel through invalidatePrincipalRecordQueries, invalidating ['principal',id], ['principals'] and ['router-terminal',id] together; qk.routerTerminal and qk.pluginReferences key factories added.
changed_contracts.impact: Router revision refreshes after every principal mutation in candidate. Candidate only.

changed_contracts.target: crates/cc-lb-admin/web/src/components/plugins/PluginCatalog.tsx + PluginDeleteDialog.tsx + queries.ts (plugin delete lifecycle and GC)
changed_contracts.deployed_behavior: GC button 'Delete unused uploads' disabled when zero unused uploads; toast 'Deleted N unused uploads'; per-row delete disabled during sweep; dialog uses del.mutate with local onSuccess toast; usePluginReferences cached normally and invalidated on delete.
changed_contracts.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: GC button 'Clean orphaned uploads' always enabled (gcInFlight latch and gcPending guard remain), toasts 'No orphaned upload blobs found' / 'Removed N orphaned upload blobs', progress label 'Cleaning orphaned uploads'; row delete no longer disabled during sweep; dialog awaits del.mutateAsync, relies on the shared MutationCache error toast, supports onDeleted callback; usePluginReferences gcTime:0, delete cancels the in-flight reference query and removes the inactive cache entry on success.
changed_contracts.impact: GC presentation clarifies that only unreferenced WASM blobs are removed (registered plugins kept even at Used By 0); delete lifecycle hardened against stale reference cache. Candidate only.

changed_contracts.name: Explicit-null Base URL override clearing
changed_contracts.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: PUT/PATCH omission preserves base_url, explicit null clears it, URL sets it. Both adapters preserve revision/credential semantics. Deployed baseline remains unchanged.

changed_contracts.name: Provider-aware configuration draft Apply availability
changed_contracts.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: draft responses expose required apply_supported from the real provider. Only explicit true may enable Apply alongside existing validation/revision checks. Unsupported and unconfirmed states show Apply-specific accessible guidance. Existing apply/reload implementations are unchanged; file-backed provider remains unsupported.
